# Lumière — Photography

> A photography portfolio demo exploring editorial, portraits, fashion, architecture, and fine art.

## Pages
- [Home](https://vibed-photography.xavainf.com/)
- [/about](https://vibed-photography.xavainf.com/about)

## Scope
This is a sample portfolio. Identities, achievements, projects, and business details are illustrative. The contact form does not send or save messages. Project pages describe bundled sample work; this site has no live business API or booking service.
